units.prompt: Review this changelog line: v2.1 upgrades the parser in place: no breaking changes, no new dependencies, and no migration steps.
Review this incident note: We blamed the GC for the pauses. It turns out that the allocator was the cause: the flame graph put 61% of samples in malloc, and pinning the arena removed the spikes.

Review this design-doc passage: Every request carries a trace id. Every trace id maps to exactly one tenant. Every tenant pins to exactly one shard. That chain is what makes cross-tenant reads impossible by construction.
Review this API deprecation note: To be clear, the v1 endpoints are unchanged: every route returns the same schema as before, and the deprecation affects only the beta batch endpoint.
